subject.title: fix(agents-bind): generate peer format for feishu group bindings

question: Which compatibility-safe Feishu bind grammar should this PR implement before merge?
rationale: The linked issue needs peer-shaped Feishu conversation bindings, but the current public CLI contract says <channel>:<account>; changing that grammar without a maintainer choice can break existing account-scoped setups.

options.title: Add explicit peer syntax
options.body: Preserve <channel>:<account> and add a documented peer form such as feishu:group:<id> or a generic peer-kind syntax for conversation bindings.

options.title: Detect Feishu conversation IDs
options.body: Map only recognizable Feishu conversation IDs such as oc_/ou_ or chat:/user: values to peers while leaving unknown values as accountId.

options.title: Keep the account escape
options.body: Accept the PR's feishu:account:<id> escape only with docs, migration/upgrade proof, and explicit ownership of existing syntax breakage.

recommendation.title: Add explicit peer syntax
recommendation.body: Preserve <channel>:<account> and add a documented peer form such as feishu:group:<id> or a generic peer-kind syntax for conversation bindings.

likelyOwner.reason: History ties this person to the public agents CLI docs and routing normalization surfaces where the compatibility decision needs to land.
